desc: Build adjacency list from the M edges (u, v, z); handle M=0 and self-loops (X_i == Y_i requires Z_i == 0, else -1).
Run iterative DFS/BFS over all vertices to assign d_v per component, verifying every edge satisfies d_u XOR d_v == z; on mismatch print -1 and exit.
For each component, collect its vertices and compute popcount per bit (bits 0..30) of d_v values.
For each bit, set root bit to 1 iff count > len(component)/2 (strict majority), forming the component's root value r.
Compute A_v = r XOR d_v for all vertices and print the N values space-separated (or -1 if inconsistent).

Review and test the current solution for correctness, edge cases, and efficiency; fix any issues found (e.g., verify bit-length handling, self-loops, M=0, memory usage, and the two-pass member reconstruction).
